summary: StealthGas Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, attaching a press release of its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports net income of $15.9 million, revenues of $42.8 million, and operational highlights including a vessel sale gain. It is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a US periodic report (e.g., 8-K for earnings). No M&A, activist, or strategic event is disclosed. The filing is purely informational with no transactional component.
